item.title: Clashes in Mawkmai Displace 1,000; Return Still Unsafe
item.description: More than 1,000 internally displaced people (IDPs) from the Kadugyi (Konglong) area of Mawkmai Township, southern Shan State, remain unable to return home despite a recent decrease in fighting, local aid workers said. Heavy clashes erupted in early February when joint forces of the military council and the Pa-O National Army (PNA) launched an offensive […] The post Clashes in Mawkmai Displace 1,000; Return Still Unsafe appeared first on Shan Herald Agency for News.
